summary: When you are already upset, someone else’s urgency can feel like a demand that your needs should wait.
body: When you are already upset, someone else’s urgency can feel like a demand that your needs should wait. When the Moon opposes Mars, emotional needs collide with pressure to act, decide, confront, or move before everyone feels ready. Something may genuinely need to happen now, but that does not mean the person most affected should absorb all of the disruption. Handle what is urgent and build protection for the people who still have to live with the consequences afterward.
